admin_login_loop.root_cause: CORS was using wildcard (*) which doesn't work with credentials
admin_login_loop.fix: Changed CORS_ORIGINS to specific origins list in .env and server.py

create_category_second_attempt.root_cause: Form state not resetting when dialog closed
create_category_second_attempt.fix: Added form reset in Dialog onOpenChange handler
